notable: aarch64 GB10 (sm_121) unified memory; the aarch64 Q4_K GEMV finding (#2567) still stands — numbers correct, speed via the scalar path. | Post-publish parity attempt 2026-09-05 (cpu lane, comparator llama.cpp 39173bcac built with -DGGML_CUDA=ON but run with -ngl 0 for the cpu lane): apr 3.5 tok/s at c=1 (TTFT 17.6 s) vs comparator 75.7 (medians of 5); 7.1 vs 104.4 at c=4 (TTFT 36 s); at c=8 and c=16 EVERY apr request failed in all 5 replicates (0/8, 0/16) while the comparator served 111.7 and 114.5 tok/s. No parity block can be emitted (PMAT-963); the aarch64 published binary is 0.046x the comparator at c=1 (PMAT-964). apr bench: 7.7 tok/s, below the H12 floor of 10, so no bench block either.

The published binary was the subject (~/.cargo/bin/apr, cargo install aprender --version 0.65.2 --locked --force).
